pillars: spectator participation and configurable N-to-K squads
collective simulated bounty; bots do not earn viewer rewards
AI chat-to-action proposals with local schema and game-rule validation
diagnostic Codex Booth using sanitized evidence, data/rules proposals, deterministic fixtures, and safe-boundary manifest activation; no executable hot-loading
fictional Twitch moderation-to-Hype and IVS congestion-to-speed-lane concepts; no real moderation or claimed sponsorship
opt-in adaptive synthesized or licensed audio
open_decisions: hazard and counter timing, eligibility, costs, and effects
wipe definition, recovery, and match continuation
reward allocation between streamer and viewers
configurable K, cohort fairness, bot behavior, and tie handling
exact reward-phase presentation and full-route art/geography

expected_handling_to_review: ambiguous or invalid chat remains a proposal and is rejected locally
